messages.subject: Weird error when using function inla.posterior.sample
parts:
Hi all,

I hope you're well safe and well. 

When I try to use inla.posterior.sample to make draws from a model output, I get the following error:

In addition: Warning message:
In file(rng.file, "rb") :
  cannot open file '/var/folders/xl/tgkddj014d72_h8r0qnpc1740000gn/T//RtmpPxJKc4/filee65813262499/filee6581e5f5dab': No such file or directory

Could someone please advise as to what I need to do to fix this? I have tried re-installing INLA and upgrading etc., to no avail.

Kind regards,

Robbie
